description: 民營飛行場一覽表 [airports and heliports] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 民用航空局. 本資料庫主要提供國內現有民營飛行場之名稱及管理單位。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 民用航空局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-04-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
